classes.name: Finding
classes.description: A reported security problem, unique per namespace by problem signature. Repeated reports are occurrences, not new findings.

properties.name: source
properties.description: Who reported it: probe, review, scanner, agent, or advisory.

properties.name: component
properties.description: Affected component.

properties.name: version_range
properties.description: Affected version range.

properties.name: problem_signature
properties.description: Stable signature that identifies the problem; findings with the same signature collapse into one.

properties.name: reported_severity
properties.description: Severity as reported by the source.

properties.name: evidence_refs
properties.description: Evidence references retained as a single string value.

properties.name: finding_class
properties.description: The class of weakness the finding belongs to, which agent disposition precision is measured per (#1990). Absent means unclassified.

classes.name: FindingOccurrence
classes.description: One measured observation of a finding. The occurrence id is unique per namespace, so a replayed observation never counts twice.

properties.name: finding_id
properties.description: The finding this occurrence observes.

properties.name: occurrence_id
properties.description: Source identifier of the observation; unique per namespace.

properties.name: observed_at_ms
properties.description: When the source observed it, in Unix milliseconds.

properties.name: evidence_refs
properties.description: Evidence references retained as a single string value.

classes.name: SecurityHypothesis
classes.description: A proposed explanation, for example from a model. It is not a measured fact and cannot be cited as exposure evidence.

properties.name: finding_id
properties.description: The finding this hypothesis is about.

properties.name: statement
properties.description: The proposed explanation.

classes.name: Exposure
classes.description: One finding against one deployed target (release and environment), with a verdict and the measured evidence used.

properties.name: finding_id
properties.description: The finding.

properties.name: release
properties.description: Deployed release of the target.

properties.name: environment
properties.description: Environment of the target.

properties.name: verdict
properties.description: exploitable, not-reachable, mitigated, or unknown.

properties.name: evidence_id
properties.description: Measured occurrence the verdict relies on; required unless the verdict is unknown.

properties.name: dependency_closure_digest
properties.description: Current digest of the deployed dependency closure.

properties.name: release_digest
properties.description: Current digest of the deployed release.

properties.name: configuration_digest
properties.description: Current digest of the configuration.

properties.name: reachable_markings
properties.description: Current comma-separated markings of data reachable from the target, or none.

properties.name: advisory_revision
properties.description: Current revision of the advisory.

classes.name: Disposition
classes.description: A decision on an exposure with the validity basis it relied on. Superseding records a new disposition; the previous one is kept.

properties.name: exposure_id
properties.description: The exposure this disposition decides.

properties.name: disposition
properties.description: accept-risk, false-positive, mitigated, fixed, or needs-review when its basis changed or it expired.

properties.name: dependency_closure_digest
properties.description: Validity basis: digest of the dependency closure the decision relied on.

properties.name: release_digest
properties.description: Validity basis: digest of the deployed release.

properties.name: configuration_digest
properties.description: Validity basis: digest of the configuration.

properties.name: reachable_markings
properties.description: Validity basis: comma-separated markings of data reachable from the target.

properties.name: advisory_revision
properties.description: Validity basis: revision of the advisory the decision relied on.

properties.name: asset_criticality
properties.description: Validity basis: the asset's effective criticality when decided.

properties.name: expires_at_ms
properties.description: When the decision stops holding; absent for no expiry.

properties.name: supersedes
properties.description: The disposition this one replaces; it keeps its history and receipt.

properties.name: rationale
properties.description: Why the decision was taken.

properties.name: reopened_fact
properties.description: On a needs-review disposition: the basis fact that changed, or expires_at_ms when it expired.

properties.name: reopened_value
properties.description: On a needs-review disposition: the fact's value that reopened it.

properties.name: recorded_by
properties.description: The principal that submitted the disposition. Stamped at write; a caller cannot set it (#1990).

properties.name: recorder_revision
properties.description: The definition revision of the site agent that recorded the disposition, when an agent did. Stamped at write (#1990).

properties.name: recorder_kind
properties.description: Whether the recorder was an agent when it recorded the disposition: agent or human. Stamped at write, so a later registry change does not rewrite history (#1990).

classes.name: RegressionProbe
classes.description: A regression probe bound to a fixed disposition: it fails on the vulnerable revision and passes on the fixed one (#1989).
classes.kind_description: A regression probe bound to a fixed security disposition.

properties.name: disposition_id
properties.description: The fixed disposition this probe proves. Bound to the disposition, not the exposure, so a later disposition decides afresh.

properties.name: exposure_id
properties.description: The exposure the disposition decides. Stamped at write.

properties.name: probe_kind
properties.description: catalogue for a Chisei isolation catalogue probe, external for a test in another repository.

properties.name: probe_ref
properties.description: The catalogue probe id, or the external test reference.

properties.name: vulnerable_revision
properties.description: The revision the probe ran on with the weakness present.

properties.name: vulnerable_result
properties.description: The probe's result on the vulnerable revision; it must fail.

properties.name: fixed_revision
properties.description: The revision the probe ran on with the fix.

properties.name: fixed_result
properties.description: The probe's result on the fixed revision; it must pass.

classes.name: Remediation
classes.description: A typed plan on an exposure: an optional patch, mitigating controls from a fixed catalogue, and an optional rollout.

properties.name: exposure_id
properties.description: The exposure this plan remediates.

properties.name: finding_id
properties.description: The finding the exposure records. Stamped at write.

properties.name: controls
properties.description: Comma-separated catalogue entries kind:target.

properties.name: patch_ref
properties.description: Change request id for the patch.

properties.name: rollout_ref
properties.description: Delivery plan or recall proposal id.

properties.name: two_person
properties.description: When true, propose, apply and lift park for a second principal.

properties.name: asset_criticality
properties.description: low, medium, high or critical. High and critical park for a human.

classes.name: Mitigation
classes.description: One reversible mitigating control from a remediation plan.

properties.name: remediation_id
properties.description: The decided remediation this control belongs to.

properties.name: exposure_id
properties.description: The exposure. Stamped at write.

properties.name: finding_id
properties.description: The finding. Stamped at write.

properties.name: control
properties.description: Catalogue control this mitigation applies.

properties.name: target
properties.description: Action type, marking, tool id, or outbound destination, matching the plan.

properties.name: state
properties.description: applied, lift_proposed, or lifted.

properties.name: gateway_audit
properties.description: pending after a decided gateway apply, until the gateway records its audit.

properties.name: marking_audit
properties.description: pending after a decided marking raise, until the lattice records the raise.

relations.name: hypothesizes
relations.description: A hypothesis is about a finding.

relations.name: exposes
relations.description: An exposure places a finding on a deployed target.

relations.name: evidenced_by
relations.description: An exposure verdict relies on a measured occurrence.

relations.name: proves
relations.description: A regression probe proves a fixed disposition.

relations.name: remediates
relations.description: A remediation plan decides how an exposure is contained and fixed.

relations.name: mitigates
relations.description: A mitigation applies one catalogue control from a remediation plan.
